function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (as of 2026). These companies are involved in research, development, production, and distribution of vaccines for a wide range of diseases, from routine childhood immunizations to emerging infectious threats.

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines / Platforms | Key Highlights |
|---------|--------------|-----------------------------|----------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (COVID‑19 mRNA), HPV, RSV, influenza | First mRNA COVID‑19 vaccine; strong global supply chain; expanding mRNA platform to other pathogens. |
| **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA‑1273 (COVID‑19), RSV, influenza, malaria | Rapid mRNA vaccine development; strong pipeline for next‑generation mRNA vaccines. |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | Ad26.COV2.S (COVID‑19), HPV, meningococcal, influenza | Single‑dose adenovirus‑vector COVID‑19 vaccine; broad vaccine portfolio. |
| **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | NVX-CoV2373 (COVID‑19), influenza, RSV | Protein subunit COVID‑19 vaccine; strong safety profile; expanding subunit platform. |
| **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (COVID‑19), HPV, influenza, malaria | Adenovirus‑vector COVID‑19 vaccine; global distribution agreements; active in low‑resource settings. |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Fluzone, Menveo, Vaxzevria (COVID‑19), HPV | One of the largest vaccine producers; strong presence in Europe and Africa. |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | Shingrix, HPV, influenza, meningococcal, COVID‑19 (with Pfizer) | Strong adjuvant technology; focus on high‑impact vaccines. |
| **Merck KGaA (MSD)** | Darmstadt, Germany | Gardasil (HPV), RZV (Shingles), COVID‑19 (with Pfizer) | Global vaccine leader; strong research pipeline. |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | CoronaVac (inactivated COVID‑19), influenza, typhoid | Inactivated virus platform; large domestic market; expanding global reach. |
| **Sinopharm (China National Pharmaceutical Group)** | Beijing, China | BBIBP‑CorV (inactivated COVID‑19), influenza, hepatitis B | State‑owned; extensive domestic distribution; active in many countries. |
| **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Covaxin (inactivated COVID‑19), influenza, typhoid | Indigenous vaccine platform; strong presence in India and neighboring countries. |
| **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | CVnCoV (COVID‑19), influenza, RSV | Non‑modified mRNA platform; early-stage pipeline. |
| **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Polio, measles, rubella, influenza, COVID‑19 (with Pfizer) | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume; key partner for WHO’s Gavi program. |
| **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer‑BioNTech)** | Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (COVID‑19), HPV, influenza | Strong manufacturing capacity in Europe. |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** | Tokyo, Japan | Shingrix (shingles), HPV, influenza, COVID‑19 (with Pfizer) | Focus on high‑quality biologics; expanding vaccine portfolio. |
| **Eli Lilly & Co.** | Indianapolis, USA | COVID‑19 vaccine (under development), influenza, RSV | Emerging vaccine division; leveraging biologics expertise. |
| **Boehringer Ingelheim** | Ingelheim, Germany | Influenza, RSV, COVID‑19 (with Pfizer) | Strong biologics platform; active in respiratory disease vaccines. |
| **Roche** | Basel, Switzerland | COVID‑19 vaccine (under development), influenza, RSV | Strong diagnostics and biologics; exploring vaccine partnerships. |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | Ad26.COV2.S (COVID‑19), HPV, meningococcal | Single‑dose adenovirus‑vector vaccine; strong global distribution. |
| **Novartis** | Basel, Switzerland | COVID‑19 vaccine (under development), influenza, RSV | Strong biologics platform; exploring vaccine collaborations. |

### How to Use This List

- **Research & Development**: If you’re looking into vaccine R&D, focus on companies with active pipelines (e.g., Moderna, CureVac, Novavax).
- **Supply Chain & Procurement**: For procurement, consider companies with robust global distribution networks (e.g., Serum Institute, Sanofi, GSK).
- **Emerging Markets**: Companies like Bharat Biotech and Serum Institute have strong presence in low‑ and middle‑income countries.
- **Technology Platforms**: mRNA (Pfizer‑BioNTech, Moderna, CureVac), adenovirus‑vector (AstraZeneca, Janssen), protein subunit (Novavax), inactivated virus (Sinovac, Sinopharm).

If you need more detailed information on a specific company, such as financials, pipeline status, or recent clinical trial results, let me know!
